faq.q: What is a lifestyle product photo?
faq.a: It is a photo that shows your product inside a believable room or scene, such as a kitchen counter or a cafe table. It helps shoppers picture using the item.

faq.q: How do I make one from a plain product photo?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, choose a scene and describe the setting in one sentence. The generated photo places the item in that scene.

faq.q: Does it replace my plain product image?
faq.a: No. Keep a plain view so shoppers can inspect the item and its size. The lifestyle scene shows where it fits into daily life, and the two work together.

faq.q: Which scenes work for home goods?
faq.a: A bedside table, a calm shelf or a kitchen counter gives a lamp, pillow or dish a clear place in the home.

faq.q: Can I show how the product is used?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a scene where the use is easy to follow, with a person or hands interacting with the item.

faq.q: Can the photo run in social ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add any price or offer in your ad editor, not on the image.

faq.q: Can I ask for a close-up detail?
faq.a: Yes. Request a close view of a texture, clasp, seam or other feature, and compare it with the real product.

faq.q: How is this different from a real photoshoot?
faq.a: A shoot needs props, a space and often a crew. Here the scene is generated from one existing photo in minutes, at far less cost.
